ranked.headline: Learned protein models assessed against explicit baselines and stringent test regimes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test structure, docking, stability and design models on lipid complexes, mutational depth and binder ranking.

ranked.headline: Integrative models partition regulatory inputs across chromatin and cis-element states
ranked.summary: Multimodal epigenomic datasets now support explicit partitioning of regulatory inputs in sequence-based and single-cell models.

ranked.headline: Histology and expression models impute and denoise spatial transcriptomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple histology, scRNA-seq references and generative models to impute unmeasured spatial gene expression.

ranked.headline: Gene set enrichment tools expand statistical scoring and reference-free feature ranking
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 preprints and publications introduce enrichment and prioritization tools that refine statistical inference from transcriptomic and omics data.

ranked.headline: MD and free energy methods resolve conformational states and binding energetics
ranked.summary: Recent items apply MD, Markov state models and ML-guided enhanced sampling to disordered regions, membrane permeation and protein allostery.

ranked.headline: ML and coarse-grained models capture protein conformational ensembles and dynamics
ranked.summary: Generative ensemble models and new force fields are now coupled to MD and Markov state models to estimate protein conformational populations.

ranked.headline: Structure-guided tools infer protein function, aggregation and variant impact
ranked.summary: Structure predictors and constraint frameworks are now used to flag spurious proteins, redesign active sites and interpret disease-associated variants.

ranked.headline: Methods for sequencing-based inference, benchmarking, and evolutionary genomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and an OrthoFinder extension target distortion, runtime, and scale limits in sequencing-based genomic inference.

ranked.headline: Sequence-resolved profiling reveals context rules for nucleic acid editing and design
ranked.summary: Deep sequencing, covariation models, and ML-guided design now quantify function at individual-sequence resolution across editors, capsids, riboswitches, and…

ranked.headline: Testing neural mechanisms via population geometry and representational drift statistics
ranked.summary: Recent work judges explicit mechanistic models by population geometry, tuning-drift statistics, and habituation parameter inference.

ranked.headline: Bayesian and neural methods infer cell lineage trees and early fate transitions
ranked.summary: CRISPR lineage recordings and single-cell transcriptomes now support joint inference of lineage trees, proliferation, and early fate transitions.

ranked.headline: Preference learning and RL steer generative design of small molecules and antibodies
ranked.summary: Generative small-molecule and antibody design models are being steered with preference learning, RL, and feature-level interpretability.

ranked.headline: Learned embeddings and domain subgraphs lower the cost of orthology inference
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings and domain-restricted search are emerging as alternatives to all-vs-all comparison for orthology and pangenomes.

ranked.headline: Tools for single-cell identity assignment, demultiplexing, and ambient RNA correction
ranked.summary: Atlases at population scale and multi-level annotation tools now demand benchmarked, scalable methods for assigning cell identity across tissues and species.

ranked.headline: Checking whether omics integration and batch correction preserve correlation structure
ranked.summary: Integration and correction steps now face scrutiny for distorting the structure downstream analyses rely on.

ranked.headline: Missense variant resources add structure, functional labels, and population context
ranked.summary: Large-scale structural, functional, and population-level missense resources now enable benchmarking and drug-target annotation in open form.

ranked.headline: Graph learning over biological networks predicts gene and protein-level outcomes
ranked.summary: Knowledge graph topology and graph isomorphism architectures are being tuned to improve prediction of gene essentiality, perturbation responses, and biological…

ranked.headline: Trajectory and clock models map aging and disease progression in cells and tissues
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair trajectory inference with epigenetic clocks to model disease progression and aging across single-cell and bulk data.

ranked.headline: Evaluation choices shape reported quality of biomolecular prediction models
ranked.summary: Held-out and out-of-distribution evaluations now expose metric-dependent rankings and identifiability limits in biological foundation and surrogate models.

ranked.headline: Leakage-audited benchmarks test whether drug-response models transfer across cohorts
ranked.summary: Drug-response models are increasingly judged on cross-cohort transfer and calibration rather than in-sample accuracy alone.

ranked.headline: Imposing cortical topography on learned models of brain activity and connectivity
ranked.summary: Spatial smoothness objectives and surface-based topography maps are now structuring fMRI models, though all four items are unreviewed preprints.

ranked.headline: Genotype-based methods resolve haplotypes, structural variants, and tandem repeats
ranked.summary: Population-scale long-read and SNP-array datasets now support haplotype and variant inference without parental or full-depth sequencing.

ranked.headline: Open software tools standardize analysis of omics and microscopy image data
ranked.summary: Accessible, standardized software is lowering the barrier to analyzing proteomic, spatial, RNA, and imaging datasets.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic models add uncertainty and structure to genomic and proteomic inference
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs Bayesian signature discovery and copula-based miRNA target prediction with spatially adjusted proteomic survival modeling.

ranked.headline: Relational models infer single-cell transitions, velocities, and perturbation responses
ranked.summary: Single-cell data now supports counterfactual editing, tissue-graph interventions, and mechanistic state inference from snapshot and time-series profiles.

ranked.headline: Known-truth benchmarks test annotation and clustering tools against reference answers
ranked.summary: Reference-based evaluation is being applied to cytometry annotation, scRNA-seq clustering and cancer genome analysis before downstream inference is trusted.

ranked.headline: Gene loss, duplication and HGT reshape eukaryotic and viral genome evolution
ranked.summary: Two-decade viral metagenomes, eukaryogenesis phylogenomics and cryonotothenioid genomes now resolve gene-level gains and losses across lineages.

ranked.headline: Pretrained protein and molecular embeddings reused for lineage and property prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained encoders are being redirected from their original objectives toward taxonomic lineage and ADME prediction in recent preprints.

ranked.headline: LLM Agents Paired With Statistical Scoring For Biomedical Evidence Analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair LLM assistants with pathway analysis, Bayesian hypothesis scoring, and section-aware retrieval over biomedical literature.

ranked.headline: Deep models fuse priors and transcriptomic data for cell, gene, and protein prediction
ranked.summary: Transformer, graph, and LLM-based models now embed regulatory priors and multi-omic data into single-cell and spatial transcriptomics.

ranked.headline: Peptide and intact-protein mass spectrometry resolves proteoform-level variation
ranked.summary: Bottom-up, top-down, and reference-assisted mass spectrometry tools now address proteoform-level variation with statistical and reference-based methods.

ranked.headline: RNA-DNA contacts and transcript composition link RNA features to regulatory states
ranked.summary: Improved RNA-DNA interaction calling and velocity-integrated regulatory networks now test RNA-linked control of cell fate decisions.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines and targeted classifiers are standardizing microbial sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Reproducible end-to-end pipelines now operate directly from SRA accessions, while classifiers report explicit memory and runtime trade-offs.

ranked.headline: Learned models advance de novo peptide sequencing and metabolic flux prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply learned models to spectral peptide sequencing and genome-scale metabolic prediction.

ranked.headline: Dynamical models couple molecular kinetics to tissue patterning and epithelial rigidity
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend reduction-and-coupling dynamical models from molecular kinetics to tissue and population-scale outcomes.

ranked.headline: Auditing imputation and representation choices in sparse sequencing and multiomic data
ranked.summary: Sparse single-cell, multimodal and long-read data now feed analyses where imputation and representation choices require explicit auditing.

ranked.headline: Single-cell foundation model gains depend on pretraining data and evaluation design
ranked.summary: Standard finetuning may hide pretraining-scale gains in single-cell foundation models, so evaluation design now matters for data-scaling claims.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines quantify subcellular and tissue structures in 3D microscopy data
ranked.summary: Open-source and web-based workflows now package deep-learning and semi-automated 3D segmentation and quantification into usable applications.

ranked.headline: Harmonized metadata frameworks link microscopy and single-cell data to archives
ranked.summary: National and multi-centre projects are operationalizing ontology-linked metadata to make annotated biological data reusable across facilities and archives.

ranked.headline: Non-model plant genomes reveal structural divergence and horizontal gene transfer
ranked.summary: New chromosome-scale assemblies for wheat, Shatavari and Zuloagaea extend reference-grade genomics to additional non-model plant taxa.
